subject: Quarterly Report Update
body:
Hi Andrew,
Please find the attached quarterly report. Let me know if you have any questions.
Best,
Albert

subject: Re: Quarterly Report Update
body:
Thanks Albert,
I have received the report and will review it today.
Regards,
Andrew

subject: Re: Meeting Invitation
body:
Hi Carol,
I will be there. Looking forward to it.
Best,
Bob
